description: Patch schema for the committed LTX 2.3 Q5 text-to-video API workflow.

unmapped_ui_parameters.steps: The committed workflow uses ManualSigmas at node 21 instead of a direct steps input.

output.contract: Return the first SaveVideo artifact as the generated MP4 path.
